question:
(i) Name the type of wavefront produced by a point source.
(ii) Name the type of wavefront produced by a distant source. Give reason in each case.

options.A:
(i) A point source produces a spherical wavefront because light spreads equally in all directions from it.
(ii) A distant source produces an approximately plane wavefront near the observer because a small portion of a spherical wavefront of very large radius appears plane.
options.B:
(i) A point source produces a plane wavefront because all rays are parallel.
(ii) A distant source produces a spherical wavefront because light spreads in all directions.
options.C:
(i) A point source produces a cylindrical wavefront.
(ii) A distant source produces a circular wavefront because its radius is small.
options.D:
(i) A point source produces no wavefront.
(ii) A distant source produces a wavefront only in vacuum.
